title: Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic's record IPO fails to stem an AI sell-off; SoftBank falls ~15%, TSMC falls 5%+, and Samsung and SK Hynix fall 6%+
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 2:40 AM ET, November 20, 2026.

summary: William Sandlund / Financial Times : Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic's record IPO fails to stem an AI sell-off; SoftBank falls ~15%, TSMC falls 5%+, and Samsung and SK Hynix fall 6%+ — Asia's markets follow Wall Street lower despite Claude AI maker's record listing — Technology stocks in Asia
